results.title: A descriptor carrying no epoch at all
results.evidence: a descriptor carrying no revocation epoch bypasses the floor entirely: `_refuse_stale_epoch` returns early when `stamped is None`, and all four shapes of absence — no `authority`, no `revocation`, no `epoch`, a null `epoch` — take that branch against an engine sitting at epoch 12.
